title: Detailed house
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='8' y='82' width='84' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4caf50'/>

  <!-- main house body -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='56' height='36' rx='2' fill='#e8a87c'/>

  <rect x='22' y='60' width='56' height='2' fill='#c9855e'/>
  <rect x='22' y='72' width='56' height='2' fill='#c9855e'/>
  <rect x='38' y='48' width='2' height='12' fill='#c9855e'/>

  <rect x='30' y='62' width='2' height='10' fill='#c9855e'/>
  <rect x='68' y='62' width='2' height='10' fill='#c9855e'/>

  <polygon points='14,50 50,18 86,50' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <polygon points='14,50 50,18 50,50' fill='#a93226'/>

  <line x1='30' y1='40' x2='44' y2='40' stroke='#8b1a1a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <rect x='64' y='24' width='10' height='20' rx='1' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <rect x='64' y='24' width='3' height='20' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <rect x='62' y='22' width='14' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0522d'/>

  <circle cx='69' cy='16' r='3' fill='#b0b0c0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#c0c0d0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='6' r='2' fill='#d0d0e0' opacity='0.3'/>

  <rect x='27' y='55' width='4' height='4' fill='#b3e5fc' opacity='0.8'/>

  <rect x='62' y='54' width='12' height='12' rx='1' fill='#4fc3f7'/>

  <line x1='62' y1='60' x2='74' y2='60' stroke='#5d4037' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <circle cx='36' cy='66' r='2' fill='#e91e63'/>
  <rect x='61' y='67' width='14' height='4' rx='1' fill='#6d4c41'/>

  <line x1='45' y1='91' x2='55' y2='91' stroke='#bdbdbd' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- grass tufts -->
  <polygon points='18,84 20,80 22,84' fill='#66bb6a'/>
  <polygon points='14,84 16,81 18,84' fill='#43a047'/>
  <polygon points='78,84 80,80 82,84' fill='#66bb6a'/>
  <polygon points='82,84 84,81 86,84' fill='#43a047'/>

  <!-- sun -->
  <circle cx='85' cy='14' r='7' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <line x1='85' y1='3' x2='85' y2='0' stroke='#ffeb3b' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <line x1='78' y1='7' x2='75.5' y2='5' stroke='#ffeb3b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='95' y1='14' x2='98' y2='14' stroke='#ffeb3b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='75' y1='14' x2='72' y2='14' stroke='#ffeb3b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
